title: Andantino in C
short: Fernando Sor (1778–1839) · C 4/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: A calm two-part piece: a tune in quarter and half notes on the top three strings, over slow bass notes played by the thumb. Let the bass notes ring for their full length while the fingers walk on above them. In the middle section the open G string sounds between the tune and the bass, like a soft bell; in the last part the opening tune comes back with a new ending.

blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: Andantino, one of Sor’s short lessons for beginners, as printed in A. Eggers’s Guitar-Skole (19th century)

sources.name: Mutopia Project edition (from A. Eggers’s Guitar-Skole, The Royal Library, Copenhagen; CC BY-SA 3.0 typesetting, the music public domain). All three voices read twice and compared with this file note by note.
